documents.title: Industry News and Vendor Updates
documents.content: SandebTech maintains a curated news page linking to official vendor announcements across SHIPFLOW, CAESES, Lotus Micro, HVAC, fire safety and turbomachinery. Articles are not reproduced; each entry links directly to the publisher so you always read the authoritative version. Visit the news page for the current list.

documents.title: SHIPFLOW Public and Custom Training Programme
documents.content: FLOWTECH runs recurring public and custom training covering the RANS, potential flow and SHIPFLOW MOTIONS solvers, with workflows for resistance, self-propulsion and seakeeping aimed at practising naval architects.

documents.title: RANS Methods for Ship Design
documents.content: Overview of the XCHAP viscous solver covering double model and free surface computation, the stern-flow turbulence model, and the overlapping grid technique used for appendages at model and full scale.

documents.title: Resistance and Propulsion Consulting
documents.content: FLOWTECH performs resistance and propulsion simulation with SHIPFLOW, producing speed-resistance and speed-power curves, with continuous code validation and self-propulsion including added wave resistance for EEDI weather factor.

documents.title: CAESES Maritime Application Overview
documents.content: Design and optimization of maritime systems to decrease fuel consumption, reduce operational downtime and maximize speed, with typical energy savings around five percent and full constraint consideration across thousands of variants.

documents.title: KCS and KVLCC2 Hulls: From Fitting to Deformation and Design Exploration
documents.content: Blog article walking through fitting parametric models to the KCS and KVLCC2 benchmark hulls, then applying deformation and systematic design exploration to these widely used validation geometries.

documents.title: Early-Stage System-Level Optimization of a Fast Planing Monohull
documents.content: Case discussion of early-stage optimization for a fast planing monohull, addressing the system-level trade-offs that dominate high speed craft design before detailed engineering begins.

documents.title: CAESES Turbomachinery Application Overview
documents.content: Generate and optimize complex turbomachinery geometries for higher efficiency, with over a thousand blade geometries from one model, around ninety percent less manual modelling and turnaround in days instead of weeks.

documents.title: Lotus Micro Engineering Solutions
documents.content: Advanced marine engineering solutions covering offshore structures, vessel dynamics and seakeeping analysis, alongside hull design support and simulation-driven naval design workflows.

documents.title: TCAE for HVAC and Thermal Systems
documents.content: TCAE supports design and analysis of cooling, ventilation and refrigeration systems with accurate fluid flow and heat transfer simulation, integrating CFD, FEA, FSI, acoustics and optimization in one workflow.

documents.title: TCAA Aeroacoustic Analysis Module
documents.content: TCAA applies the acoustic analogy approach to CFD results, covering low-frequency sound through high-frequency noise and turbulence, with applications spanning HVAC, automotive, aerospace and industrial equipment.

documents.title: Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS) and Smokeview
documents.content: NIST maintains FDS, the large eddy simulation code widely used for fire-driven fluid flow, together with the Smokeview visualisation tool. The site hosts releases, verification and validation guides and technical reference manuals.

documents.title: SFPE Fire Protection Engineering Resources
documents.content: The Society of Fire Protection Engineers publishes guidance, handbooks and professional resources underpinning performance-based fire safety design and tenability assessment practice worldwide.

documents.title: TCAE Release Webinars and Case Studies
documents.content: CFD SUPPORT runs regular webinars introducing each TCAE release, covering multiphase simulation, numerical robustness, parallel scalability and mesh-interface workflows for turbomachinery and rotating equipment.

documents.title: FDA Pump Benchmark Validation
documents.content: Public validation study applying TCAE to the FDA benchmark blood pump, part of CFD SUPPORT's published benchmark set demonstrating solver accuracy against measured reference data.

documents.title: CAESES Blade Design Capabilities
documents.content: Parametric blade design covering axial turbine stages, compressor stators, radial compressors and turbines, pump impellers, inducers and blades with internal cooling channels.
